title: The Ultimate Guide to Multi-Location PPC Advertising on Google Ads | seoplus+

facts.fact: The seoplus+ guide 'The Ultimate Guide to Multi-Location PPC Advertising on Google Ads' was published on May 22, 2024.
The seoplus+ guide lists an estimated reading time of 21 minutes.
According to the seoplus+ guide, multi-location businesses can be broadly categorized into three distinct types.
facts.quote: Multi-location businesses can be broadly categorized into three distinct types, each with its own operational structure and management needs.

facts.fact: The seoplus+ guide defines enterprises as typically large companies with operations spanning multiple geographic regions, including international borders.
facts.quote: Enterprises are typically large companies with operations that span multiple geographic regions, including international borders.

facts.fact: The seoplus+ guide defines franchises as operating under a model where individual business owners buy licenses to open and operate a store under a larger brand's name.
facts.quote: Franchises operate under a model where individual business owners buy licenses to open and operate a store under a larger brand’s name.

facts.fact: The seoplus+ guide states that stores of a brand with multiple stores are not independently owned and are managed directly by the company.
facts.quote: Unlike franchises, these stores are not independently owned but are managed directly by the company.
